net.floodlightcontroller.core

Class OFConnection

  • java.lang.Object
    • net.floodlightcontroller.core.OFConnection
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    IOFConnection, IOFConnectionBackend, IOFMessageWriter

    public class OFConnection
extends java.lang.Object
implements IOFConnection, IOFConnectionBackend
    Implementation of an openflow connection to switch. Encapsulates a Channel, and provides message write and request/response handling capabilities.
    Author:
    Andreas Wundsam

      • write

        public void write(org.projectfloodlight.openflow.protocol.OFMessage m)
        Description copied from interface: IOFMessageWriter
        Writes to the OFMessage to the output stream.

        Note: this method has fire-and-forget semantics. When the connection is not currently connected, it will silently discard the messages.

        Specified by:
        write in interface IOFMessageWriter

        Description copied from interface: IOFMessageWriter
        write an OpenFlow Request message, register for a single corresponding reply message or error message.
        Specified by:
        writeRequest in interface IOFMessageWriter
